shortDescription: Electric vehicle manufacturer XPeng Inc. NYSE:XPEV reported strong September deliveries of 41,256 vehicles, representing a 5% M/M increase from August. children: of 41,256 vehicles, representing a 5% M/M increase from August. Monthly performance was anchored by the XPENG L03, which delivered over 10,000 units.
For the third quarter of 2026, total deliveries reached 118,390 vehicles, marking a 15% sequential gain compared to Q2.

On the product front, XPeng officially launched its premium G9L SUV in China on September 17, with an international rollout scheduled for October in Paris, France. Additionally, on September 22, the automaker began rolling out XOS 6.3.0 in China, powered by the latest version of its VLA 2.0 autonomous driving model.

As of September 30, XPeng’s self-operated charging network spanned over 430 cities in China, featuring more than 4,000 stations, including 3,510 ultra-fast charging locations, and over 22,200 charging piles.
The company also opened its first X-Energy megawatt ultra-fast charging station in Hong Kong on September 15.

On the sustainability front, XPeng estimates that vehicles delivered from January through September 2026 will reduce life-cycle greenhouse gas emissions by more than 4.14M tons compared to internal combustion engine vehicles, equivalent to the carbon absorbed by 68.53M young trees over a 10-year period.

title: XPeng delivers 41,256 EVs in September, up 5% M/M; Q3 total reaches 118,390
